scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c cyan,green "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.start: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c cyan,green "npm run start -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.model: PYTHON=python3; if [ -x .venv/bin/python ]; then PYTHON=.venv/bin/python; fi; $PYTHON -m uvicorn --app-dir model-server app_mistral:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000
scripts.model:cpu: DEVICE_MODE=cpu PYTHON=python3; if [ -x .venv/bin/python ]; then PYTHON=.venv/bin/python; fi; $PYTHON -m uvicorn --app-dir model-server app_mistral:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000
scripts.model:gpu: DEVICE_MODE=gpu PYTHON=python3; if [ -x .venv/bin/python ]; then PYTHON=.venv/bin/python; fi; $PYTHON -m uvicorn --app-dir model-server app_mistral:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000
